messages:
Maya Chen: Quick rollcall — I'm drafting the one-pager for the API v2 deprecation. Need clear owners for: SDK (JS/Py), gateway proxy shim, docs/changelog, console feature-flag, support runbook. Proposed timeline: announce -> canary -> global cutover. Canary target week: Apr 6. Who can own which lane? @Sophie @Kevin @Samir

Kevin Ortiz: I can own the gateway shim and canary infra. Will open the shim PR today and add a compatibility toggle. Assigning myself for rollout ops.

Sophie Patel: I’ll take JS SDK. Python SDK is trickier this cycle — @Lina any chance docs team can help coordinate the migration guide? I expect a major bump (breaking): semver + codemods. Targeting a prerelease the week of Apr 6 for canary.

Samir Rao: Runtime/infra here — I’ll validate backward routing and add a fallback route for legacy clients during the canary. I need the exact request payloads that are failing in v2 tests. Can someone drop a small test vector set?

Lina Gomez: Docs + changelog owner. Happy to do migration guide + in-console banners. Can we use a single markdown template? I’ll draft one and ping for review.

Maya Chen: Thanks — action items: Kevin = gateway shim PR + canary playbook, Sophie = JS SDK + prerelease, Lina = docs + banners, Samir = runtime fallback + test harness, need a support runbook owner and QA test vectors.

Elena Park: Support runbook is on me. Can you include standard rollback steps and the list of error signatures we should watch for? I also need the support-facing FAQ snippets.

Ravi Singh: QA will produce the test vectors. I’ll export 30 representative requests (short/long context, function-calling, streaming). ETA Tue Mar 26. Will post them to the QA bucket and link here.

Kevin Ortiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/719 — initial shim + feature flag. Please review. I also added a short playbook in the PR description for the canary toggle steps.

Samir Rao: Looking at the PR now. Kevin — can you add a healthcheck endpoint that returns the shim version? That makes canary verification easier: `GET /.shim-health` -> {"shim":"v1.2.0"}.

Kevin Ortiz: Yep, adding healthcheck in the next commit.

Sophie Patel: For SDK: here's the migration checklist I'm using: 1) bump dep 2) run integration tests against runtime v2 3) opt-in flag for preview 4) docs snippet + codemod. Will open the JS PR tomorrow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/401

Maya Chen: Perfect. Two coordination asks: 1) canary window specific day/time so infra/support can staff; 2) update the public roadmap note so customers see the deprecation timeline.

deploy-bot: Canary tentative slot requested: Tue Apr 7 02:00-06:00 UTC. Confirm owners and I'll lock the slot.

Elena Park: Apr 7 window works for support. I'll be on-call. Please add me to any PagerDuty runbook links.

Ravi Singh: QA will schedule regression run immediately after the canary window. Please ensure test vectors are linked in the PRs.

Lina Gomez: Docs draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — includes banner copy and FAQ. PTAL.

Maya Chen: Great momentum. Final checklist before I send the external note: owners (Kevin, Sophie, Lina, Samir, Elena), canary slot Apr 7 02:00-06:00 UTC, PRs linked (gateway, sdk-js, docs). Anything blocking a tentative announce?

Samir Rao: One blocker: we need a load profile from product for canary traffic shape (p95 seq lengths, typical token counts). @Product please drop that — otherwise we might not catch perf regressions.

Kevin Ortiz: Also calling out: need QA to add a smoke test that asserts old-client requests map to expected responses. Ravi, can you add that to your list?

Ravi Singh: Yup — smoke test added to the canary pipeline. I’ll post the pipeline link when ready.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll compile the one-pager and send the external deprecation note after PR reviews land. Leaving this thread open for any late blockers. :thumbsup:
